Short reads (L = 4 to 5) achieve high matching rates (71% to 87%) because short fragments pack tightly into cyclic rows with high density. Long reads (L = 8 to 10) form longer contiguous superstring chains with higher overlap lengths, requiring balanced 2D allocation across both horizontal rows and vertical columns.
